explanation: deploy:cf now runs prepare:deploy, build, verify:release, wrangler deploy and verify:deploy without precompress; deploy:dist remains the Apache build. The default build emits a self-destroying sw.js and registers no worker (VITE_SERVICE_WORKER=1 restores it), public/_headers keeps /sw.js no-cache so old installs pick up the stub, and delivery.md and DEVELOPMENT.md document both.
